item: PF10 built: the map's controls fold into one in-map button below 600 px
summary: At 390 px the map's control groups covered 79% of the world map (112% with the worldview picker). Below 600 px they now sit in one panel behind a single labelled in-map button (aria-expanded, keyboard-operable); opened, the panel stacks the groups below the map. Desktop is unchanged. Two new strings keyed x12. Walked in Chromium at 390 px English and Arabic and 1280 px, worldview drop-down opened and an option picked at each.
